messages:
sam: Heads-up — we're scheduling the new runtime+quota dashboard rollout next week. Need alignment on alert thresholds and how these should route to oncall. TL;DR: quotas, SLO burn rates, and whether quota-exhaustion should page vs notify.

liz: +1 we need concrete thresholds. recommend: page on quota_exhaustion if sustained >95% capacity for 5m, otherwise ticket. also page for SLO burn rate > 3x expected over 10m.

diego: For runtime signals, the main inputs are: request_latency_p50/p95, kv_cache_miss_rate, grpc_retry_rate, serving_pool_utilization. We can emit a combined "stress" metric that tags quota_pressure and runtime_heat so dashboards can show correlated views.

maya: UX ask: console should show a single alert card that links to the quota rollup + per-region runtime graphs. If it pages, the card needs quick actions: mute/ack/route to dedicated team.

oliver: On routing: prefer primary oncall for infra/runtime for pages during hours. If it's quota-related and customer-affecting, escalate to platform-oncall after 10m. Proposed escalation: primary_runtime -> platform_oncall -> infra_sev2.

sam: That escalation chain sounds OK. For non-paging notifications (like crossing 80% for a burst), we'd send to #platform-ops with a ticket.

liz: Example Grafana-style rule (pseudo):

```
alert: QuotaExhaustionHigh
expr: max_over_time(serving_pool_utilization[5m]) > 0.95
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
  team: runtime
annotations:
  summary: "Serving pool >95% for 5m"
  runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quota_exhaustion"
```

liz: And SLO burn rule:

```
alert: SLOBurnFast
expr: increase(slo_error_budget_consumed[10m]) / increase(slo_error_budget_consumed[1h]) > 3
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
  team: platform
annotations:
  summary: "SLO burn >3x expected (10m window)"
```

diego: Minor note — the slo_error_budget_consumed metric needs to be exported by the console eval pipeline. I'll add the exporter and a feature flag. ETA EOD Thursday.

maya: For dashboard rollout, put a banner in the console feature toggle that warns about new paging defaults and links to docs. We should allow orgs to opt-out of paging for quota alerts for their dedicated clusters.

oliver: Need oncall rotations updated. If we page runtime team, oncall-bot should create incident with label "quota" and include previous 30m trace + top 3 hot nodes. Can someone add that to the alert annotation?

sam: Good call. Liz/diego can we add the incident payload to the alert annotation (short link) and include the hot nodes via the query? Example annotation field: `hot_nodes: {{ $labels.node_list }}`.

liz: We can add a link to the pre-filled incident form: `https://incidents.redwood/create?source=alert&alert=QuotaExhaustionHigh&range=30m` in the annotations. Pulling node list in the alert is doable but keep it short.

diego: I'll add the metric label flattening so alerts can include `node_list`. Will also ensure the combined stress metric is backfilled.

sam: Permissions question — if customers opt out, we should still surface the alert as "notify" to the tenant admin but not page Redwood oncall. Maya, can the console set per-org paging override?

maya: Yes — we have a per-org alerting policy config. We'll add a flag `page_on_quota_exhaustion: true|false` and default to true for hosted accounts, false for private deployment unless enterprise enabled. Docs will call this out.

oliver: One more operational detail: set a cool-down so repeated pages for the same quota incident don't re-page the same person within 30m. Use `for: 5m` plus alert grouping by cluster_id and a `dedup_window: 30m` in the alertmanager routing.

sam: Routing bullets we agreed on: 1) page on high severity (quota_exhaustion >95% 5m) to runtime primary, 2) auto-escalate after 10m to platform, 3) non-page notify at 80% to platform-ops channel, 4) per-org opt-out for paging. I'll draft the PR for the alert rules and the routing config.

liz: When you open the PR include PromQL samples and a test playbook. I'll review the pages and run a smoke test with oncall-bot.

deploy-bot: Deployed alert-exporter v2 to staging (build 2026-03-20-1145).

sam: Nice — let's target a canary rollout Mon next week. I'll schedule a 30m sync with runtime + oncall to walk through the runbook and escalation.

oliver: +1. Put me on the invite.

maya: I'll add the console banner and opt-out toggle to the rollout checklist.

sam: Thanks everyone. Action items: sam PR for alert rules and routing, diego exporter and node_list label, liz smoke test and runbook updates, maya console opt-out and banner.
